# Ecclesiastes Chapter 1 -- The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1:1** The-words of-Qohelet [the-Assembler], son of-David, king in-Yerushalayim.

**1:2** Vapor of-vapors [havel havalim], says the-Assembler [Qohelet], vapor of-vapors — the-all [ha-kol] [is] vapor [havel].

**1:3** What profit [yitron] [is there] to-the-human [la-adam] in-all his-toil [amalo] that-he-toils under the-sun [tachat ha-shemesh]?

**1:4** A-generation [dor] goes and-a-generation comes, and-the-earth to-forever [le-olam] stands.

**1:5** And-rises the-sun and-sets the-sun, and-to its-place it-pants [sho'ef], rising there.

**1:6** Going to the-south and-turning to the-north, turning turning goes the-wind [ha-ruach], and-upon its-turnings returns the-wind.

**1:7** All the-streams [ha-nechalim] go to the-sea, and-the-sea is-not full; to the-place where the-streams go, there they return to-go.

**1:8** All things [are] wearisome [yegeim] — a-man is-not-able to-speak; the-eye is-not satisfied to-see, and-the-ear is-not filled from-hearing.

**1:9** What has-been — it [is] what will-be; and-what has-been-done — it [is] what will-be-done. And-there-is-nothing [ein kol] new [chadash] under the-sun.

**1:10** There-is a-thing of-which one-says, "See this — it [is] new!" Already it-was in-the-ages [le-olamim] which were before-us.

**1:11** There-is-no remembrance [zikaron] of-the-former-things [rishonim], and-also of-the-latter-things [acharonim] that-will-be — there-will-not-be remembrance of-them with-those-who will-be at-the-end [la-acharonah].

**1:12** I, Qohelet, was king over-Yisra'el in-Yerushalayim. **1:13** And-I-gave my-heart [libbi] to-seek and-to-search-out [la-tur] by-wisdom [ba-chokhmah] concerning all that-is-done under the-heavens — it [is] an-evil task [inyan ra] God has-given to-the-sons of-the-human to-be-occupied with-it.

**1:14** I-saw all the-works [ha-ma'asim] that-are-done under the-sun, and-behold, the-all [is] vapor [havel] and-striving-after [re'ut] wind [ruach].

**1:15** The-crooked [me'uvvat] is-not-able to-be-straightened [litqon], and-the-lacking [chisaron] is-not-able to-be-counted [lehimmanot].

**1:16** I-spoke, I, with my-heart, saying, "Behold, I have-made-great and-added wisdom over all who were before-me over Yerushalayim," and-my-heart saw much [harbeh] wisdom and-knowledge [da'at].

**1:17** And-I-gave my-heart to-know wisdom and-to-know madness [holelot] and-folly [sikhlut]; I-knew that also this — it [is] striving-after wind.

**1:18** For in-much wisdom [is] much vexation [ka'as], and-he-who-adds knowledge adds pain [makh'ov].

---

## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.2 — hevel havalim:** The superlative construction (like "holy of holies" or "king of kings") marks this as the most extreme form of *hevel*. The word occurs 38 times in 12 chapters — more than the rest of the Hebrew Bible combined.

**v.3 — yitron:** A commercial term meaning "profit" or "surplus" — used only in Ecclesiastes. Qohelet frames life's meaning in economic terms, then shows the ledger never balances.

**v.5 — "pants/hastens":** The Hebrew *sho'ef* means "gasps" or "pants" — the sun is personified as exhausted, hurrying back to start again. A vivid image of cosmic weariness.

*-- EMET*
